stemMd: Which EU institution normally proposes new EU legislation and represents the common EU interest?
explanationMd: The Commission normally initiates EU legislation and promotes the Union's general interest. Parliament and the Council of the EU usually negotiate and adopt legislation. Proposal and adoption are distinct functions.

distractorRationale.d: Its central role concerns monetary policy.
distractorRationale.a: It audits EU finances rather than normally proposing laws.
distractorRationale.e: It sets overall political direction rather than normally initiating legislation.
distractorRationale.b: A municipality is not the EU's executive institution.
